definitions.explanation: The part of the morning just before midday, roughly from ten to twelve o'clock. {昼前|ひるまえ}に means "before noon" or "in the late morning".

examples.japanese: {昼前|ひるまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I got up late in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昼前|ひるまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The package will arrive before noon.

examples.japanese: {昼前|ひるまえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いた→降り続く：21878_furitsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: It started to rain in the late morning and kept raining all afternoon.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昼過|ひるす}ぎ→昼過ぎ：12966_hirusugi⟧: early afternoon, just after noon
- ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧: the whole morning, from midnight to noon; {昼前|ひるまえ} is only its last hours
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by noon, a deadline; {昼前|ひるまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ only places something in the late morning
